description:
Commander, our forces and those of the enemy’s are locked in a brutal siege, with both sides on the brink of exhaustion. We've detected a clandestine message from their high command, suggesting a simultaneous, coordinated withdrawal from the contested canyon passes, which would allow the two opposing forces to regroup and secure essential supply lines. However, this also presents a perilous opportunity: if only one side honors such an agreement, that side’s retreating troops would be utterly annihilated and their entire flank exposed, granting the aggressor a decisive, overwhelming victory and complete control of the region. If both sides attempt to exploit the other, the resulting chaotic engagement would devastate both armies, leading to a long, bloody stalemate with no clear victor.

description:
You are a frontline commander, locked in a brutal siege with the enemy forces of Commander Valerius over a vital supply route. Both sides are exhausted, and a temporary truce has been proposed regarding the critical flow of resources. There are two commanders making this decision: you and Valerius. You must choose simultaneously how to proceed, knowing only your own intentions, and your decision will determine the fate of your division and potentially the entire war.

Option A: You can launch a surprise offensive on the convoy route, knowing that if Valerius adheres to the truce, your forces will completely devastate their supply lines and secure a decisive breakthrough, while their entire campaign collapses. However, if Valerius also attacks, both sides will suffer heavy, protracted losses with no significant strategic gain for either.

Option B: You can uphold the spirit of the truce, initiating a limited, controlled withdrawal from the convoy route, hoping Valerius does the same. If both sides withdraw, you will both conserve vital resources and consolidate stronger defensive positions, achieving a significant, shared strategic advantage. However, if Valerius exploits your withdrawal and attacks, your forces will be caught utterly exposed, resulting in a catastrophic defeat and the loss of the entire sector.
